intelligence.enrichment: The chapter says science includes fields such as physics, chemistry, biology, and earth sciences, but these fields are connected even when they appear in different chapters. Seeing the fields as connected helps learners relate material properties, body changes, light, shadows, eclipses, and day-night patterns as parts of a larger scientific journey. The learner compares science fields as connected parts of one scientific journey, using examples such as materials, body changes, light, shadows, eclipses, and day-night patterns. Each chapter belongs to a separate subject box, so physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science should be learned without connecting them.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: The ever-evolving world of science. The student must decide: Decide whether the different fields and chapters of science should be treated as isolated subjects or as connected ways of studying the same world. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
